name: BloodBowl_Card
cardText:
Dodge, Fend, Hypnotic Gaze, 
Loner (4+), Prehensile Tail, 
Safe Pair of Hands, Sidestep
specialRules: Look into my Eyes: Once per game, if Boa begins his activation Marking an opposition player in possession of the ball, he may roll a D6. On a 1, nothing happens. On a 2+ the opposition player loses possession of the ball, Boa immediately gains possession of the ball, and Boa’s activation immediately ends.
